globalTips: With the USD/JPY rate at ~162.7, your dollar stretches far. Withdraw large sums from 7-Eleven ATMs for the best rates rather than exchanging cash at airports, and use a no-foreign-transaction-fee credit card for larger purchases.

December in Japan is cold and dry, but rain can happen. Always carry a compact umbrella and dress in layers—mornings at shrines will be near freezing, while department stores and trains will be heated to tropical levels.

For a group of 8, always split the squad when restaurant seating is tight (izakayas, ramen shops) and reconvene later. Use mobile ordering at places like Ichiran to sit in adjacent solo booths simultaneously.
